questions.question:
In an imaginary mathematical system, P denotes subtraction, Q denotes division, R denotes addition and S denotes multiplication. All other rules of mathematics are the same as in the existing system. What is the value of the given expression?

106 R 115 Q 23 S 7 P 19
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 **Symbol**
 
 

 P 
 -
 
 

 Q
 ÷ 
 
 

 R
 +
 
 

 S
 × 
 
 

Given expression : 106 R 115 Q 23 S 7 P 19

After replacing the symbols in place alphabet in given expression the expression is as follows : 106 + 115 ÷ 23 × 7 - 19

= 106 + __**115 ÷ 23**__ × 7 - 19

= 106 + __**5 × 7**__ - 19

= __**106 + 35**__ - 19

= __**141 -**____** 19**__

**= 122**

Hence, the correct answer is **"122".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ b _ p p p _ q p _ p b _ p _

options.text: b q b p b p
p b q p b q
p q b p q p
p q p p q b

questions.solution:
Given :- _ b _ p p p _ q p _ p b _ p _

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) b q b p b p → **b** b **q** p p - p **b** q p **p** - p b **b** p **p**

2) p b q p b q → **p** b **b** p p - p **q** q p **p** - p b **b** p **q**

3) p q b p q p → **p** b **q** p p - p **b** q p **p** - p b **q** p **p**

 
• Here **"pbqpp"** is repeated.

4) p q p p q b → **p** b **q** p p - p **p** q p **p** - p b **q** p **b**

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- p b q p p - p b q p p - p b q p p

Hence, the correct answer is **"p q b p q p".**

questions.question: When 12 is added to a number, it is equal to 2 times the sum of 4 and the number. Find the number.
questions.solution:
Given,

When 12 is added to a number, it is equal to 2 times the sum of 4 and the number.

Let us consider the number = X

⇒ X + 12 = 2(X + 4)

⇒ X + 12 = 2X + 8

⇒ 2X - X = 12 - 8

∴ X = 4

So, the number X = 4

Hence, the correct answer is "4".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number.

54 : 9 :: ? : 7
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Second number × 6 = First number.**

54 : 9 → 9 × 6 = 54

Similarly,

? : 7 → 7 × 6 = 42

Hence, the correct answer is **"42".**
